skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of supply and demand, business operations, market structures, pricing, output, growth, and investment decisions.
Grasp economic cycles, government policies, and international capital flows.
Identify and solve investment-related issues, and make informed investment decisions.
Develop skills in research, analysis, and synthesis of investment-related issues, understanding regulatory policies, and analyzing investment-related policies.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively to solve investment-related issues.
Show the capacity for self-study, seeking out materials to complete assigned tasks and assignments.
Maintain discipline in class, adhere to classroom rules, and demonstrate a cooperative and responsible attitude towards assigned activities.
